description: Choose covenants, then intercept drifting judgments with the matching seal before they strike their witnesses.
name: Consequences Boss V2 · Difficulty 3 · Simplified Interaction
natural_language: Choose MERCY or REBUKE for every witness, then START JUDGMENT. Apply each witness's chosen seal to its moving rune before impact. White-ring wisps are protected. Before START JUDGMENT, covenant choices may be changed and preparation gestures may be retried. The first missed cast, broken covenant, protected-wisp strike, judgment impact, or rejected SUBMIT ends the episode; a later attempt cannot pass. Fine threads show upcoming motion. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload or navigation, browser extensions, external applications, or other implementation or hidden-state access. Do not switch to any pre-existing, unrelated, blank, settings or non-task tab. A tab opened by a visible task control is allowed only as part of this task, using its visible controls.
